# Platform admin console: permissions

The platform operator's console. Its administrators are a separate realm and never members of an organization.


## Who can do it

Built-in roles and role templates whose permissions pass each route. Owner and administrator are included where the route allows them.


## Routes

| Method | Path | Requires | Data scope | Step-up | Roles that pass |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/admin/access-requests` | no permission: platform-admin realm: AdminAuthMiddleware (X-Admin-API-Key or console session cookie, RFC-022) + RequireRole; /admin/auth/login\|mfa\|logout are the public console login steps (rate-limited); not tenant-permission-gated | system: platform-admin realm (RFC-022) |  | see Requires |
| POST | `/api/v1/admin/access-requests/{id}/approve` | platform administrator role | system: platform-admin realm (RFC-022) |  | Owner, Administrator, Member, Viewer, CTEM program lead, Security analyst, Vulnerability manager, Remediation owner, AppSec engineer, Scan operator, Validation engineer, External tester, Threat intelligence analyst, Risk approver, Auditor, Executive viewer |
